links.quote: “The Knee Guide” had a significantly higher DISCERN score than ChatGPT 4 ( p < 0.001).

The mean FRES of “The Knee Guide” was 60 (range 47–76, ±7.83) indicating good readability consistent with an 8th grade reading level, while ChatGPT 4 had a mean FRES of 32 (range 14–47, ±8.3) indicating significant complexity in the level of readability of responses produced consistent with an RGL of a College graduate.
The mean FKGL for the “Knee Guide” was 8.2 (range 5–10.7, ±1.42), while responses given by ChatGPT 4 had a mean FKGL of 13.99 (range 11–16, ±1.39) ( Figure 1 ).
